cases.name: Ellie Faye Steele
cases.about: Her obituary said, "In the short time Ellie spent on this earth, she filled every moment with light. She was a happy baby- innocent, sweet, and full of joy. Her tiny hands, bright eyes, and gentle spirit brought a depth of love that will stay with all the lives she touched. Ellie had an infectious smile that would brighten anyone's day. Though her life was brief, it was immeasurably meaningful."
cases.narrative:
An autopsy was completed and the medical examiner reported that the infant suffered injuries consistent
with blunt force trauma.
